statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : ℕ → KdVPlan.Coeff), (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (f n)) → (∀ ε > 0, ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ m, ∀ j ≥ m, KdVPlan.HB s (f n-f j) ε) → ∃ g, KdVPlan.SeqConv s f g
proof:
classical
intro s f hf hc
choose x hx using fun n => (yui_aux_0004 T gamma R s (f n)).1 (hf n)
have hd : ∀ n j, dist (x n) (x j) = KdVPlan.hn s (f n-f j) := by
  intro n j
  rw [dist_eq_norm, ← (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R s (x n-x j)).2,
    yui_aux_0005 T gamma R, ← hx n, ← hx j]
have hcx : CauchySeq x := by
  apply Metric.cauchySeq_iff.2
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hc (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  intro n hn j hj
  rw [hd]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hm n hn j hj).2 (by linarith)
obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcx
refine ⟨KdVPlan.FromLP s y, (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R s y).1, ?_⟩
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 ((Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 hy) ε hε)
refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
intro n hn
have he : f n-KdVPlan.FromLP s y = KdVPlan.FromLP s (x n-y) := by
  rw [yui_aux_0005 T gamma R, ← hx n]
rw [he]
refine ⟨(yui_aux_0003 T gamma R s (x n-y)).1, ?_⟩
rw [(yui_aux_0003 T gamma R s (x n-y)).2]
exact (by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hm n hn : ‖x n-y‖ < ε).le
